chapter: Dances and concerts at Economy Hall
title: Peter Bocage as director for the concerts
summary: Return to the Economy Hall concerts; Peter Bocage was director and a better leader than Piron.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: You were talking about the concerts over at the Economy Hall.

Yes, that concert, what we used to give. Well, they had that old Peter Pocan. He used to play for some of them. He's from over the river. And he used to be the director. He used to be the leader. He was a better leader than Piron. You know, because Piron wasn't the leader.
